note: Scripted validator judgments used by the demo scenarios and the test suite. On chain these come from gl.nondet.exec_prompt under the equivalence principle; here they make the deterministic engine reproducible.

company_nigeria.claim_text: Company X currently operates in Nigeria.

company_exit.claim_text: Company X closed its Nigerian operations in July 2026.

supporting_evidence: Corporate registry lists active operations (primary source, 2026-01)
verified.temporal_scope: present tense, as of evaluation date
verified.explanation: Primary registry record and one independent outlet both confirm current operations.

supporting_evidence: New primary registry filing dated 2026-04 confirms active status
strengthened.explanation: A fresh primary filing directly establishes the claim, raising confidence.

reality_changed.explanation: A primary exit notice dates the end of operations; the claim is no longer true today.

contradicting_evidence: Outlet B (2026-07-19) reports a full shutdown
conflicting_sources.contradiction_reason: Two credible outlets published contradictory claims one day apart; neither supersedes the other and no primary record settles it.
conflicting_sources.explanation: Credible disagreement remains unresolved, so the claim is reported as DISPUTED rather than false.

contradicting_evidence: A widely shared article reporting closure is dated 2024-03
apparent_contradiction_dates.contradiction_reason: The conflicting report describes a 2024 subsidiary closure, a different period and entity scope.
apparent_contradiction_dates.explanation: The apparent conflict is explained by different dates and scope, not by a change in the underlying fact.

insufficient_evidence.missing_context: No primary registry record newer than 2025 is reachable.
insufficient_evidence.explanation: Available evidence no longer establishes the claim either way; reported as UNCERTAIN.
